subject: Bundle apps for local install FOR MAC

messages.author: 6a2cf68e5127d114
messages.subject: Bundle apps for local install FOR MAC
parts:
Do you know of any workflows for how to package R, and R-shiny app, and dependencies all in one but for mac? This is for easy install for non-R users, plus for version control. 

This question has already been answered for windows here:

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/shiny-discuss/bundle/shiny-discuss/9_vjF2F3VME/r3AlanRVlpQJ

with this blogpost: http://www.r-bloggers.com/deploying-desktop-apps-with-r/

Thank you,
Liz
